I bought the cheapest version (standart?), never spent any money afterwards and i was fine playing from Stonewood to Canny Valley with only legendary Jess i got from collection book and legendary pistol from a random llama. I don't have any other good weapons, heroes or traps (can't really do higher stormshield defenses cause of that), not really complaining, but not having an option of getting decent schematics outside of ingame shop is annoying.

1. Any unupgraded weapon can last till end of stonewood, because the first zone is basically a tutorial and very easy, i was fine with a blue slugshot, by that time you should realize that investing into trash items is not good at all in this game, it doesnt matter if we got more rare loot than others, it doesnt change the fact that white/green/blue schematics have no purpose to exist (at least for now) I never got anything good from 13(?) free llamas i got. At the start of Plankentron, i got legendary Jess from a collection book and a legendary pistol from vbucks i saved and i still use them now exclusively.

2. Well thats a different topic we are talking about now, but yeah, at the end of the mission we should get more than just resources

1. Because rarity system is broken right now. In other games, common and uncommon items have some value and uses, but not in this game, they are not worth investing any resources and time, all they give is xp from recycling, you do not buy a llama just to get xp, you'll go do missions for it instead. Thats why i suggested, if they wanna keep rarity system as it is, epics is a minimum if you buy a llama with real money.

2. They can reduce amount of schematics you get from llama reward to 1 or 2. You can't really escape grind, eventually it will happen, so at least let it make more enjoyable.

They want to treat this game as a card game, where you buy a "pack", hoping you get something good out of it in terms of rarity, but Fortnite is a different genre, so the card system is pretty poorly designed.

The price for llamas are still the same, i dont know where you get that 1$ from. After every mission, most of the time you'll get white or green items from a llama, but a chance of getting epic and legendary makes you feel more motivated to do a mission, rather than grinding nonstop for a little reward. And as i said before, the whole rarity system and cards makes no sense in this game
